messages:
maria: CI microbench failure on PR #9342 — batcher_kv_hit shows +12% vs golden, threshold 5%. @sahil @lee can you take a look?
ci-bot: Automated run results: microbench/batcher_kv_hit -> baseline 1.24ms, PR 1.39ms (+12%). Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/9342/run-2026-03-10.tar.gz
sahil: looking now. quick suspicion: kernel_selector changes from the merge. running profiler on CI container.
lee: I touched warmup heuristics in the same PR last week; might interact with batching wait heuristics. will repro locally.
sahil: perf flame:
```
# brief stack sample (top 5)
runtime::dispatch
kernel_selector::select_best_kernel
kernel_launch::prepare_args
memcpy_async
kv_cache::lookup
```
shows increased memcpy and KV miss overhead.
jordan: I pulled the CI trace and KV hit-rate dropped ~6% for seq>=512. looks like kernel choice bumped to a kernel with worse KV affinity.
lee: repro command I used: `./microbench --bench= batcher_kv_hit --seq=1024 --batch=8 --warmup=20 --runs=200`
sahil: quick bisect locally points at commit abc1234 (merge: model-routing) where we changed cost_shift_multiplier in kernel_selector.cpp from 0.8 -> 1.1. that tweak moves preference to the newer tiled kernel for large seqs. diff: 
```diff
- float cost_shift_multiplier = 0.8f;
+ float cost_shift_multiplier = 1.1f; // commit abc1234
```
maria: can someone try reverting that line on the PR branch to confirm?
sahil: pushed revert candidate branch `revert-abc1234`. kicked CI on that branch.
ci-bot: Revert branch CI result: microbench/batcher_kv_hit -> 1.23ms (baseline 1.24ms). Regression gone.
maria: OK this looks like the culprit. but we need a less aggressive change than full revert.
sahil: propose: restore cost_shift_multiplier to 0.85, add unit test for kernel selection on seq distributions, and add a golden microbench for KV-hit-sensitive path. Also add a metric to CI that fails if KV hit-rate drops >3%.
jordan: agree. also we should log kernel choice in the golden artifacts to catch regressions earlier.
lee: I'll prepare a smaller patch and tests.
maria: marking this as a rollout blocker for v0.14.0 — hold merge window until patch and CI goldens are in. @eng-release please note.
eng-release-bot: Merge freeze applied to main for v0.14.0 due to perf blocker (PR 9342). No merges until PR 9350 resolves regression.
maria: thanks all. follow-up: retro to discuss why kernel selector change didn't have a perf unit test. :thumbsup:
